steps.name: Clone repo and fetch PR data
steps.command:
rm -rf /workspace/repo && gh repo clone {{ input.repository.full_name }} /workspace/repo -- --depth=100 && cd /workspace/repo && gh pr checkout {{ input.pull_request.number }} --detach && FILES=$(gh pr view {{ input.pull_request.number }} --repo {{ input.repository.full_name }} --json files --jq '.files | map("- \(.path) (+\(.additions)/-\(.deletions))") | join("\n")') && DIFF=$(gh pr diff {{ input.pull_request.number }} --repo {{ input.repository.full_name }}) && if [ ${#DIFF} -gt 100000 ]; then DIFF="${DIFF:0:100000}
... (truncated)"; fi && jq -n --arg files "$FILES" --arg diff "$DIFF" '{files: $files, diff: $diff}'

params.prompt:
You are an expert code reviewer analyzing PR #{{ input.pull_request.number }} in this repository.

## PR Information
**Title:** {{ input.pull_request.title }}
**Description:** {{ input.pull_request.body }}

## Changed Files
{{ JSON.parse(steps['clone-and-fetch'].output).files }}

## Diff
```diff
{{ JSON.parse(steps['clone-and-fetch'].output).diff }}
```

## Your Task
Perform a thorough code review of this pull request. You have access to the full codebase - use the Read and Grep tools to:
1. Examine the changed files in detail
2. Understand the context by reading related files
3. Check for consistency with existing patterns in the codebase

## Review Focus Areas
- **Bugs & Edge Cases**: Logic errors, null checks, boundary conditions
- **Security**: Input validation, authentication, authorization, injection vulnerabilities
- **Performance**: Inefficient algorithms, unnecessary allocations, N+1 queries
- **Code Quality**: Readability, maintainability, proper error handling
- **Consistency**: Following existing patterns and conventions in the codebase

## Output Requirements
Provide specific, actionable feedback with exact file paths and line numbers.
- Use APPROVE only if the code is ready to merge
- Use REQUEST_CHANGES if there are issues that must be fixed
- Use COMMENT for general feedback without blocking

Be constructive, specific, and reference actual code you've examined.

steps.name: Save checkpoint
steps.command: cd /workspace/repo && COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && echo '{"timestamp": "'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)'", "commit_sha": "'$COMMIT_SHA'"}' | jq -c .

steps.name: Check PR status and activity
steps.command: PR_DATA=$(gh pr view {{ input.pull_request.number }} --repo {{ input.repository.full_name }} --json state,headRefOid) && STATE=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.state') && if [ "$STATE" != 'OPEN' ]; then echo "$STATE" && exit 1; fi && CURRENT_SHA=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.headRefOid') && LAST_SHA=$(printf '%s' "$CHECKPOINT_JSON" | jq -r '.commit_sha') && HAS_NEW_COMMITS=false && if [ "$LAST_SHA" != "$CURRENT_SHA" ]; then cd /workspace/repo && gh pr checkout {{ input.pull_request.number }} --detach --force >&2 && HAS_NEW_COMMITS=true; fi && SINCE=$(printf '%s' "$CHECKPOINT_JSON" | jq -r '.timestamp') && NEW_COMMENTS=$(gh api repos/{{ input.repository.full_name }}/pulls/{{ input.pull_request.number }}/comments --jq "[.[] | select(.created_at > \"$SINCE\" and (.user.login | contains(\"[bot]\") | not) and (.body | contains(\"🤖\") | not))]") && jq -n --argjson has_new_commits $HAS_NEW_COMMITS --arg current_sha "$CURRENT_SHA" --argjson new_comments "$NEW_COMMENTS" '{has_new_commits: $has_new_commits, current_sha: $current_sha, new_comments: $new_comments}'

params.prompt: New commits have been pushed. Re-review the PR with the same criteria as before.

steps.name: Check if review is completed
steps.command: if echo "$LAST_OUTPUT" | grep -q '^{'; then exit 1; fi
